title: NSRT boss ability timers for one encounter
description: Output of tools/game_knowledge/nsrt_timer_import.py, one file per encounter at data/raid/<patch>/<tier>/<nn>_<slug>/timers.json -- see docs/design/23-boss-timer-dataset.md for the full spec. Difficulty keys are always strings of the in-game difficulty IDs (14=Normal, 15=Heroic, 16=Mythic), never the WarcraftLogs 3/4/5 scheme -- see docs/design/00-overview.md#vocabulary.

addon_version.description: The addon's own ## Version: from its .toc, so a stale dataset is diagnosable. Never hand-edit the addon files to change this.

extracted_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp. The one field a re-run of the tool is allowed to change.

notes.description: Free-text notes the tool couldn't determine algorithmically -- notably the BigWigs cross-check agreement/disagreement writeup this task's acceptance criteria require.

encounter.description: The encounter slug this file covers (same as encounter.slug).

dungeon_encounter_id.description: The in-game encID (NSRT/BigWigs/DBM), NOT the WarcraftLogs encounter id -- see docs/design/00-overview.md#vocabulary.

timerArray.description: Seconds from the start of the ability's phase, matching the convention docs/design/21-nsrt-note-export.md uses. Never rounded -- an integer-valued source literal like `290` stays a JSON integer, not 290.0, since the timeline editor snaps to these exact values.

^(14|15|16)$.description: Keyed by phase number as a string (e.g. "1", "1.5", "1.75", "2") -- NSRT's own `phaseTimers` field, present on multi-phase encounters instead of a flat `timers` map. See this task's PROGRESS.md entry: this field is an extension over the design doc's original schema, which only documented `timers`.

stub.description: True when the source alert has neither `timers` nor `phaseTimers` at all -- meaningful data (e.g. an untested/UI-helper alert), not a parse failure. See this task's traps section.

unresolved_fields.description: field name -> raw Lua source text, for any of this ability's fields whose value was a Lua expression the importer didn't attempt to evaluate (a function/method call, an unknown identifier). Empty for all abilities in the current venomous-abyss.json -- every field in these 9 files resolves cleanly -- but kept per-ability so a future addon update that introduces one is diagnosable instead of silently turning into a bare null.
